_comment: Controlled training-seed variance. Runs are identical except --seed. The champion is NOT among them (different validation cadence, and validation consumes RNG), so it is not weight-comparable to these.

prereg_evaluation.sd_is_an_upper_bound: The measured SD includes decode-sampling noise. Deflating by the repo's own sampling marginal (0.0121) gives 0.0814, still above the margin.
prereg_evaluation.test_calibration_warning: At this n the SD is barely estimated: the chi-square CI on sigma is [0.0466, 0.3068], whose lower bound sits near the margin. The rule fires on a point estimate the data cannot cleanly separate from the margin. The CONCLUSION -- that the comparison is underpowered -- is what a sigma interval this wide says directly, and is better supported by the interval than by the threshold rule.
prereg_evaluation.caveat: The mean-1SD comparison against DeepSeek's 0.8719 is INDICATIVE only: DeepSeek was scored on the 800-task seed-777 pool while these are 300-task seed-13 pools. A confirmatory test requires both models on the same pool under PRE-REGISTRATION section 4's matched conditions.
